a_records.quote: Consider for illustration of the theorem 4.1, the sample X1, X2, X3, X4, X5 from U(0,1) with n = 4 and n + 1 = 5. Now we know that X_{k:n} ~ Beta(k, n + 1 - k). Now we take l from Gumbel-Hougaard Copula ... as the appropriate stdf for Archimax copula model with 5-monotone Archimedean generator phi(t) = e^{-t^{1/theta}}, theta in [1, infty), where stable tail dependence function (stdf) is l(x) = (x_1^theta + x_2^theta + ... + x_n^theta)^{1/theta} with l(x) = ||x||A(x/||x||). For reverse hazard rate ordering, we calculate t phi'(t)/phi(t) = -(1/theta) t^{1/theta} which is a decreasing function of t >= 0, because for theta in [1, infty), we get d/dt (-(1/theta) t^{1/theta}) = -(1/theta^2) t^{1/theta - 1} <= 0 for all t >= 0. On the other hand F_{X_{5:5}} = x, F_{X_{4:4}} = 4x^3 - 3x^4 and equating both expression of l we have A = n^{1/theta - 1} with n = 4. Plots are shown below which illustrates the theorem 4.1 (i) for theta = 4.

records.quote: Consider two extreme value copulas Joe copula and Gumbell copula with generators respectively, phi_1(t) = 1 - (1 - e^{-t})^{1/theta_1} and phi_2(t) = e^{-t^{1/theta_2}} for theta_1, theta_2 in [1, infty]. Therefore psi_2(t) = (- log t)^{theta_2} and psi_2 o phi_1(t) = (- log(1 - (1 - e^{-t})^{1/theta_1}))^{theta_2}. Then from graphic software it can be shown that psi_2 o phi_1(t) satisfies the below property (2) namely, for A with, 1/n <= A <= 1, psi_2 o phi_1(tA) >= A psi_2 o phi_1(t) if theta_2 = 1 and theta_1 > theta_2.
records.family: Joe generator phi_1(t) = 1-(1-e^{-t})^{1/theta_1}; Gumbel generator phi_2(t) = e^{-t^{1/theta_2}}
records.compared: Joe vs Gumbel generators with theta_1 > theta_2 = 1

records.quote: Let X1, X2, ...., Xn be random variables, phi_1 and phi_2 are generators of n-dimentional Archimax copulas C1 and C2 respectively with inverse of phi_2 is psi_2. If psi_2 o phi_1 satisfies the following, (1) Super-additive. (2) For A such that, 1/n <= A <= 1, psi_2 o phi_1 (t . A) >= A psi_2 o phi_1 (t), where A : [0,1]^n -> [1/n, 1] is pickands dependence function as in equation (7). then C1(x) <= C2(x) for all x in [0,1]^n.
records.family: Archimax copula C_{phi,A}(x) = phi(||psi(x)|| A(psi(x)/||psi(x)||)); phi n-monotone Archimedean generator, A Pickands dependence function
